rows.displayName: Local smoothing for the Euclidean wave equation

claim.ja: 全 $n\ge2$ の半波動局所平滑化。臨界 $p_c=2n/(n-1)$ のannulusで $[\log(2+N)]^{2/p_c}$、全 $2\le p<\infty$ で $s_+(p)+\varepsilon$。
claim.en: Half-wave local smoothing in all $n\ge2$: $[\log(2+N)]^{2/p_c}$ on a critical annulus, and order $s_+(p)+\varepsilon$ for all $2\le p<\infty$.

role.ja: 保存流・rank 1背景の行列式エネルギー・二円環比較。BR、restriction、Schrödinger、Kakeya/Nikodymへの分岐を解説。
role.en: A conserved current, rank-one-background determinant energy and two annular comparisons. Branches to BR, restriction, Schrödinger, and Kakeya/Nikodym estimates.

rows.displayName: Critical local smoothing for the three-dimensional wave equation

claim.ja: 三次元半波動の臨界 $L^3$ 時空評価を任意の正のSobolev損失で示す。全 $2<p<\infty$、$\alpha>\max\{0,1-3/p\}$ を帰結。
claim.en: Critical spacetime $L^3$ smoothing in three dimensions with every positive Sobolev loss; consequences for all $2<p<\infty$, $\alpha>\max\{0,1-3/p\}$.

role.ja: 円筒模型の極値配置と位相記録のエントロピーによる経路。薄いround配置の移送と物理初期面の正則性を接続。
role.en: A route through extremal cylinder configurations and phase-record entropy, linked by thin-round transfer and regularity on the physical initial slice.
